label: Просить
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for просить (to ask for, to request).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. Просить is imperfective. Note the 1sg mutation с → ш in 'прошу', against просишь elsewhere. 'О помощи' shows the о + prepositional object.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Просишь' keeps the unmutated стем прос- with the -ишь ending. 'Всегда' marks a recurring habit of asking.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Просит' takes the -ит ending. 'У меня совета' shows the у + genitive source plus genitive object of the request.
Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Просим' uses the -им ending. The verb governs the accusative person 'вас' plus an infinitive 'остаться'.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Просят' closes the present set with the -ят ending. It governs the infinitive 'купить' as the content of the request.
Strategic focus: Past, masculine. 'Просил' is the masculine -л past of просить. The perfective partner попросить marks a single completed request.
Strategic focus: Past, feminine. 'Просила' adds the feminine -ла ending. The verb governs 'меня' plus the infinitive 'прийти' as the content.

missions.phrase: Они часто просили нас о помощи.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past, plural. 'Просили' is the plural -ли past, shared by all genders. 'Часто' stresses the repeated, imperfective asking.
Strategic focus: Imperative, singular. 'Проси' is the informal command of просить. 'Проси прощения' is a fixed idiom meaning to apologise.
Strategic focus: Infinitive use. 'Просить' stays in the dictionary form after evaluative 'не стыдно'. The imperfective infinitive states a general truth.
